programs = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u035/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    if divider is None:
        return out
    common = {c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and grid[-1][c] == grid[0][c]}
    for c in common:
        for r in range(1, divider):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
